# Left — Widgets for Time Left

> Left is an iPhone app that makes time visible. It turns years, months, weeks, days, and life progress into widgets, alongside countdowns to the dates ahead, habits, streaks, a daily Planner, and lightweight accountability with friends. Free to use, with an optional Left Premium subscription or lifetime unlock.

Left is built by cntxt (coded in New Zealand). Platform: iOS 18+. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/left-widgets-for-time-left/id6740155884

## Core pages

- [Home](https://getleft.app/): Overview of Left — time-left widgets, countdowns, habits, streaks, Planner, and friends.
- [Web app](https://getleft.app/web.html): Visualize your time left (year, month, week, day, life) in the browser and share as images.
- [Support](https://getleft.app/support.html): Help guides for widgets, habits, streaks, countdowns, Planner, sync, and Left Premium.
- [Tools](https://getleft.app/tools/): Free time tools — countdowns, date calculators, age, sleep, fasting, year progress, business days.
- [Blog](https://getleft.app/blog/): Guides on making time visible with iPhone widgets, habits, streaks, countdowns, and Planner.
- [Press](https://getleft.app/press.html): Press resources for Left.
- [Privacy](https://getleft.app/privacy.html): Privacy policy.
- [Terms](https://getleft.app/terms.html): Terms of service.
- [Contact](https://getleft.app/contact.html): Support, feedback, bug reports, and enquiries.

## What Left does

- Time Left widgets: see how much of the year, month, week, day, and life remains.
- Ahead dates: countdowns to trips, birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, and deadlines; import from Apple Calendar; share with friends.
- Habits and streaks: track habits on a schedule and count streaks since a start date or reset.
- Planner: one view of Apple Reminders, calendar events, habits, streaks, weather, sleep, and workouts.
- Friends: add friends by username to share dates, habits, and streaks for accountability.
- 20+ widgets, You, Wallpaper, Time Between, Live Activities, and games.
- Sync: automatic sync across iOS devices through a free Left account.

## FAQ

Q: Is Left free?
A: Yes. Time Left, over 20 widgets, You, Wallpaper, Friends, Time Between, games, and other core tools are free forever. Left Premium unlocks deeper ways to track habits, streaks, special dates, and your day.

Q: How does Left Premium work?
A: Left Premium is available as a subscription for as long as you want to use it, or as a lifetime purchase that unlocks the app forever. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

Q: Why does Left calculate my time left?
A: Because time is easier to ignore when it stays abstract. Left turns years, months, weeks, days, hours, minutes, and life progress into visible symbols so you can see what has passed and what remains.

Q: What are Ahead dates?
A: Ahead dates are countdowns for future moments: trips, birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, deadlines, retirement, or anything else you want to look forward to. You can import dates from Apple Calendar and share countdowns with friends.

Q: What's the difference between a habit and a streak?
A: A streak counts how long something has continued since a start date or reset. A habit asks you to complete something on a schedule: daily, multiple times per day, weekly, monthly, or custom. Both live in Since.

Q: Can I use Left with friends?
A: Yes. Add friends by username to share Ahead dates, habits, and streaks. Friends can keep you accountable on your streaks and habits, or share and join a special date ahead together.

Q: How does Planner help with my day?
A: Planner brings your day into one view: Apple Reminders, calendar events, habits, streaks, weather, sleep, workouts, and more.

Q: Does Left sync across my devices?
A: Yes. Left syncs automatically between your iOS devices. Countdowns, habits, streaks, and friends sync through your free Left account.

## Languages

The site is available in 18 languages under locale prefixes (e.g. https://getleft.app/es/, /de/, /fr/, /ja/, /zh-Hans/). English is the canonical default at the root.
